findings.title: Stable Channel Update for Desktop (Chrome 152.0.7977.82/.83)
findings.summary_md: Google's Chrome stable channel advisory, dated Thursday, September 3, 2026, ships 152.0.7977.82/.83 for Windows and Mac and 152.0.7977.82 for Linux. It fixes High CVE-2026-85046, a type confusion in V8 reported by Salvatore Gulizia (Serotav) on 2026-08-04, and states Google is aware an exploit for CVE-2026-85046 exists in the wild.

findings.title: When Sorting Leads To Confusion (CVE-2026-85046 write-up)
findings.summary_md: The original researcher disclosure by Serotav (Salvatore Gulizia), dated by the commit that published it on his GitHub on 2026-09-08. It details the V8 Maglev/TurboFan type confusion in the inlined Array.prototype.sort, where a comparator calling Array.fill() flips elements kind mid-sort to gain addrof and arbitrary read/write on the JS heap, chained with an n-day sandbox escape for his v8CTF submission.

findings.title: Mind the (Patch) Gap: Multiple Chinese Threat Actors Chain 0-day Exploits in Chrome & Windows (Volexity, Part 1)
findings.summary_md: Volexity's first disclosure of the chain, documenting Chinese actors UTA0560 and JungleBamboo (APT31/TA412) exploiting CVE-2026-85046, CVE-2026-87491, and CVE-2026-85880 starting September 1, 2026. It reports CVE-2026-85046 was reported to Chromium on August 4, 2026, and was fixed in Chromium source but absent from shipped Chrome, making it a patch-gap zero-day. UTA0560 delivered the GRIMWEDGE JScript backdoor to NGOs while JungleBamboo installed the SUPERSTOMP loader and LONGTALE credential-stealing Chrome extension.

findings.title: Once in a BlueMoon: Multiple State-Aligned Threat Actors Rapidly Adopt Novel Exploit Chain Using Chrome and Windows Zero-Days (Proofpoint)
findings.summary_md: Proofpoint names the exploit kit BlueMoon and identifies four espionage-motivated users by September 9, 2026: TA412 (first observed August 28, 2026), UNK_LateNight (ShadowPad against US aerospace from September 2), UNK_DoubleCheck (Rust loader against a Vietnamese manufacturer from September 2), and UNK_QuietRacket (Singapore and Indonesia from September 3). The post dates the CVE-2026-85046 fix commit to August 7, 2026 and stable Chromium rollout to September 3, 2026, and releases ET rules 2071919-2071924 plus the MAL_BlueMoon_ExploitKit YARA rule.

findings.title: Microsoft Patches Record 974 Flaws, Including Two Exploited Windows Zero-Days
findings.summary_md: Coverage of September 2026 Patch Tuesday, in which Microsoft fixed a record 974 flaws including actively exploited CVE-2026-85880 (CVSS 7.8), a heap-based buffer overflow in Windows ALPC allowing an authorized attacker to gain SYSTEM privileges, credited to Volexity and Proofpoint. CISA added the flaw to the KEV catalog on September 8, 2026, with federal remediation due September 22, 2026.

findings.title: China-Linked Hackers Exploit Chrome-Windows Zero-Day Chain to Deploy GRIMWEDGE
findings.summary_md: Earlier news coverage of the same chain, reporting Volexity's findings that UTA0560 exploited the three flaws to deploy GRIMWEDGE against NGOs on September 1, 2026, and that JungleBamboo used the identical chain for the SUPERSTOMP loader and LONGTALE extension. It frames the incident as N-day bugs in Chromium source that remained zero-days against released Chrome due to the four-week release cadence.

findings.title: Mind the (Patch) Gap, Part 2: Fake Websites Used to Deploy Chrome & Windows 0-Day Exploits (Volexity)
findings.summary_md: Volexity's disclosure of UTA0565, the third Chinese actor using the BlueMoon chain, which attacked on September 3-4, 2026 via spoofed sites including americanprgoress[.]top and chinadigitaltimes[.]top with exploits in a hidden config.html iframe. The campaign delivered the previously undocumented CLEANGULP backdoor as chrome_cleanup.exe (SHA256 8858ea412dc306b3558885af18006c5ca24689e8875733b5e13b3c2692e603cb), persisting via a MicrosoftIME scheduled task and beaconing over HTTP to the typosquat domain thecovnresation[.]com. Seven related typosquat domains were registered September 2-4, 2026.
